player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" while in the Exercise room, which still had an available direction (north) leading to an unvisited room. My mistake was failing to verify that all reachable paths were exhausted before stopping. Next time, I will strictly follow a rule: only issue "DONE" when the list of currently available directions is empty or when I have confirmed that all adjacent rooms have already been visited. In this specific scenario, I should have executed "GO: north" from the Exercise room to continue the exploration rather than stopping.
